about: What the API's own tests assert its fake GitHub receives for the revision reply and the merge notice, copied verbatim. Those tests need the API database, so a tools test cannot run them; tests/test_live_github_chain_driver.py builds its posts to satisfy exactly these assertions and routes them by path, and tests/test_live_github_chain_pending.py::test_pending_notice_assertions_match_the_api_tests skips when a copied line no longer reads the same in its source.

checks_line.note: No API test asserts this line; it is copied from the renderer, which appends it to the request's status body once its checks passed.
asserted_lines: f"observed at {when} after the run ended."
checks_line.format: Checks passed on head {head}, observed at {when} after the run ended.

asserted_lines: (result,) = [part for part in ticket_after.split("\n\n") if merged in part]
